description:
The 24" 21-speed women's mountain bike is designed for those who crave adventure on the trails and beyond. Built with a durable steel frame, this bike offers both strength and stability, ideal for navigating through rough terrains, gravel paths, and forest trails. With a height range of 5'-5'8" inches, it's perfectly suited for a wide range of riders, ensuring a comfortable and safe fit. The 21-speed drivetrain allows for smooth, quick shifts, giving you the flexibility to adjust gears effortlessly as you tackle uphill climbs or cruise on flat surfaces. Equipped with high-quality, all-terrain tires, it provides excellent traction and puncture resistance, so you can confidently ride through dirt, gravel, and paved paths with ease.

For added convenience, the bike comes 85% pre-assembled, meaning you'll only need to attach a few parts like the front wheel, handlebars, and pedals. After a quick adjustment of the brakes and gears, you'll be ready to hit the road or trail. Whether you're using it for mountain biking, commuting, or leisurely rides, this bike promises durability, comfort, and an enjoyable ride. Plus, with a no-questions-asked return policy within 31 days, your purchase is completely risk-free.

Premium Steel Frame--Built with a durable 24" steel frame, this mountain bike is designed to withstand rugged terrain and provide a smooth, stable ride. Suitable for riders with a height range of 5'-5'8", it's the perfect choice for outdoor enthusiasts who enjoy trails, gravel paths, or simply exploring the great outdoors.
